scheme_name: Food Safety & Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) Compliance Support
overview: The Food Safety & Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) Compliance Support scheme provides guidance and assistance to food businesses for adhering to food safety regulations, including licensing, registration, standards formulation, and compliance with fortification and labeling requirements. It aims to ensure availability of safe and wholesome food through regulatory oversight, capacity building, and stakeholder engagement. The scheme supports food business operators, regulators, and consumers via training, advisories, and digital platforms like FoSCoS and Food Safety Connect.
objectives: Establish science-based standards for articles of food
Regulate manufacture, storage, distribution, sale, and import of food
Ensure availability of safe and wholesome food for human consumption
Promote coordination of work on food standards with international bodies
Build capacity of food safety officials and food business operators through training
Provide digital platforms for licensing, compliance, and grievance redressal
Support fortification of staple foods to address micronutrient deficiencies
Enable consumers to report misleading claims and food safety concerns
eligibility: Eligibility varies by service: For standard formulation, submission of representation or request with scientific rationale is required. For NSF & FI approval, food products/ingredients covered under FSS (NSF & FI) Regulation, 2017 are eligible. For vegan logo approval, submission of documents as per guidelines including source of ingredients, certificate of analysis for absence of cholesterol, lactose, animal DNA from NABL accredited laboratory is required. For FSMP approval, submission of scientific, clinical, and epidemiological data for dietary management of specific disease/disorder/medical condition is required. For import NOC/NCR, consignments must comply with FSS Act, 2006, Rules, and FSS (Import) Regulations, 2017. For food laboratory recognition, laboratory must have accreditation under FSSAI-NABL Integrated Assessment. For Food Analyst examination, candidates must possess essential educational qualifications (Bachelor’s/Master’s/Doctorate in specified fields) and not less than three years’ experience in food analysis at recognized institutions. For FBO training, eligibility criteria are specified in FoSTaC portal links. For RTI, only citizens of India are eligible. For CPGRAMS, only citizens of India are eligible to file grievances.
benefits: Non-financial benefits include access to scientific rationale-based standard formulation, approval of non-specified foods and food ingredients, vegan logo endorsement, approval of foods for special medical purposes, issuance of NOC/NCR for imported food consignments, recognition and notification of food testing laboratories, Food Analyst certification, training of FBOs and regulatory staff, RTI facilitation, CPGRAMS grievance redressal, and access to advisories, circulars, and digital tools like Food Safety Connect and FoSCoS. Financial benefits are not explicitly mentioned as direct subsidies or grants; however, some services involve applicable fees (e.g., Rs. 50,000 + GST for NSF & FI approval, Rs. 10,000 + GST for vegan logo, Rs. 2500–5000 + GST for Food Analyst exam, Rs. 60,000 + 18% GST for ED-FSR diploma). Financial assistance is provided to states (e.g., FSSAI providing financial assistance to Assam for upgrading laboratories dedicated to pesticide testing).
financial_support: FSSAI does not provide direct financial subsidies or grants to beneficiaries under this scheme. Instead, it charges applicable fees for various services such as approvals, examinations, and trainings. Financial support is extended selectively to state governments for specific purposes, such as upgrading laboratories for pesticide testing in Assam. Fees for services include: Rs. 50,000 + GST for NSF & FI approval, Rs. 10,000 + GST per application for vegan logo endorsement, Rs. 2500–5000 + GST for Food Analyst examination (CBT and practical), Rs. 60,000 + 18% GST for the ED-FSR diploma program, Rs. 2000 visual inspection fee and sample testing fees for import NOC/NCR, Rs. 1000 application processing fee for food laboratory recognition, and Rs. 2500 + GST for Food Analyst CBT. No direct grant or loan disbursement to food businesses is evidenced.
application_process: 1. Identify the required service (e.g., standard formulation, NSF & FI approval, vegan logo, FSMP, import NOC, lab recognition, Food Analyst exam, FBO training, RTI, CPGRAMS grievance). 2. Visit the relevant portal or division as specified (e.g., FoSTaC portal for FBO training, FoSCoS for licensing, FSSAI website for RTI/CPGRAMS, labs@fssai.gov.in for lab recognition). 3. Prepare and submit the required application form (e.g., Form-I for NSF & FI, Form-A for lab recognition, Annexure for claims, Form for vegan logo, dossier for FSMP). 4. Attach required documents (e.g., scientific rationale, source of ingredients, certificate of analysis, NABL accreditation, educational qualifications, experience proof, identity/address proof). 5. Pay applicable fees via FSSAI ePayment portal or other specified modes (e.g., https://epay.fssai.gov.in/). 6. Submit application via email, online portal, or physical submission as directed (e.g., labs@fssai.gov.in for lab recognition, online for Food Analyst exam). 7. Await processing and approval as per indicated timeframes (e.g., 04-06 months for NSF & FI, 06-09 months for claims, 04-06 months for vegan logo, 09-12 months for FSMP, 2-10 days for import NOC/NCR, 01-09 months for lab recognition, 01 year for Food Analyst certification). 8. Receive approval, certificate, notification, or service delivery upon successful completion.
required_documents: Scientific rationale of the proposal (for standard formulation)
Form-I of the sub-regulation (1) of regulation 4 of FSS (NSF & FI) Reg. 2017 (for NSF & FI approval)
Source of ingredients, Certificate of Analysis for absence of cholesterol, lactose, animal DNA from NABL accredited laboratory (for vegan logo)
Submission of scientific, clinical and epidemiological data (for FSMP approval)
Consignment documents complying with FSS Act, 2006, Rules, and FSS (Import) Regulations, 2017 (for import NOC/NCR)
Scanned/pdf format of requisite documents, duly filled FORM A, and fee receipt of Rs. 1000 (for food laboratory recognition)
Scanned copies of original degree certificates or provisional degree certificates (for Food Analyst examination)
Proof of identity and address (for RTI application)
Personal details, grievance details, and supporting documents (for CPGRAMS grievance)
Aadhaar Card, Mobile Number, and documents to prove eligibility/experience (for FBOs under FoSTaC)
Written application, application fee (₹10), and proof of identity/address (for RTI)
Registration on CPGRAMS portal and online form submission (for CPGRAMS grievance)
deadlines: Rolling basis — no fixed deadline. Applications are accepted year-round.
implementing_agency: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)

caveats: No upper age limit for appearing in Food Analyst Examination

Experience gained before or after the period from graduation to closing date of application, and during academic programmes (e.g., Post Graduate, Doctoral), will not be considered for Food Analyst eligibility

Candidates must select applicable discipline (Chemical or Biological) while filling application form for Computer Based Test (CBT) and Practical Examination for Food Analyst, and cannot change it till completion of examination
Only those candidates who qualify the practical examination and fulfill all prescribed eligibility criteria will be eligible to undergo the mandatory two-week Food Analyst Training
All training-related expenses for Food Analyst Training shall be borne by FSSAI
Candidates who successfully complete Food Analyst Training shall be issued Food Analyst Certificates by hand at FSSAI Training Centres
No fees for trainings conducted by Staff Training Unit for FSSAI Officials
Residential trainings at NPC, ISTM, FOIR, etc., are nominated via email at training@fssai.gov.in
The standard fee for filing an RTI application is ₹10; applicants below poverty line (BPL) are exempt upon providing BPL certificate
CPGRAMS portal is accessible 24/7 and connected to all Ministries and Departments of Government of India and States
Time taken in redressal of public grievances received through CPGRAMS portal is 21 days
Monitoring of grievances by Senior Officers is conducted via CPGRAMS
FSSAI will only accept fresh proposals from laboratories for recognition and notification if the laboratory has obtained accreditation under FSSAI-NABL Integrated Assessment

No such security deposit shall be payable by a laboratory owned or controlled or funded or operated by any statutory body or Government institution or Government-aided or funded institution including research institution or University recognized under the University Grants Commission Act, 1956
